slice 1 bounds: options patch_radius 1..8 (default 3), em_iterations 1..64 (4), search_iterations 1..32 (4), max_levels 1..16 (8), threads 1..64, max_hole_pixels (1<<20) -> retouch_out_of_range / content_aware_hole_too_large; pyramid working bytes (112 B/pixel over every level + output plane) charged against max_bytes before allocation; work (patch-pixel visits of recompute + sweeps + votes) charged against max_work before synthesis -> budget_exceeded; unimplemented STU-RAS-143 values (colour_adaptation high/very_high, rotation_adaptation != none, scale, mirror) -> content_aware_option_unsupported; no valid source -> content_aware_no_source; RetouchError gains ContentAwareNoSource, ContentAwareHoleTooLarge, ContentAwareOptionUnsupported (non_exhaustive enum, additive)

slice 2 content_aware::patch(target, region, source_offset (p reads p + offset), PatchMode normal = retouch heal along the offset (receipt.blend with source_offset) | content_aware{structure 1..7} = fill guided by q + offset: coarsest hole starts from the dragged pixels, initial match q + offset, every later candidate within the Chebyshev window 2^(10 - structure) px of q + offset at level 0, halved per level); source rect must lie inside the target (retouch_out_of_range)

slice 2 content_aware::content_aware_move(target, selection, offset (p shows p - offset), MoveMode move|extend, sampling, options, limits) -> MoveResult{result, fill receipt, paste HealReceipt}: move fills the vacated selection with the destination footprint excluded from sampling, then places the object (colour_adaptation none = source-over with selection coverage via retouch::paint_over; default = retouch heal with the moved original as guide); destination outside the target places nothing; damage = union of hole and visible destination

notes.algorithm_provenance: implemented from the published papers only: Wexler, Shechtman, Irani 2007 'Space-Time Completion of Video' (global patch-coherence EM, weighted voting, coarse-to-fine) and Barnes, Shechtman, Finkelstein, Goldman 2009 'PatchMatch' (randomized NNF, propagation, random search with halving radius); Jacobi (parallel) propagation instead of the papers' sequential scan order so bytes do not depend on threads; Poisson blend reuses retouch heal (Perez, Gangnet, Blake 2003). No implementation source read (permissive or otherwise); no new dependency; no dep request.
